why: Searches turned up only known pre-2024 partial results (2-rearrangeability, counterexamples to shortest-path routing) and an unrelated 2024/2025 paper (Chakrabarty-Seshadhri, arXiv:2409.02206) on directed hypercube routing for monotonicity testing that does not mention Szymanski's conjecture and concerns vertex-disjoint paths between sub-level sets, a different problem. The Wikipedia article shows no indication of resolution.
